evd_title: GPT 3.5-turbo achieved the highest correct answer rate of 66.9% on STROBE checklist questions across 39 medical articles
finding: GPT 3.5-turbo achieved the highest correct answer rate of 66.9% on STROBE checklist questions across 39 medical articles
P: 39 observational obesity studies from PubMed (33 for Claude v1); 15 STROBE questions x 10 trials
I: 6 LLMs with RAG, zero-shot, T=0.1: GPT 3.5-turbo-1106, GPT 4-0613, GPT 4-1106, Claude v1, PaLM 2, Gemini Pro 1.0
C: Gold answers from 1 medical professor (verified by 1 epidemiologist); other LLMs
T: PubMed search 19 Dec 2023, articles from last 5 years; paper 2024
